The second station downstairs.
The Changing Station in the Nursery. A pad you can work at with one hand staying on your baby the entire time.

What done looks like:
1. Cream all touchable without moving your feet or lifting your hand off your baby
2. A lined pail within one step
3. Two spare outfits in the drawer directly beneath the pad
4. A pad surface with nothing stacked on it
